pages.lesson:
LESSON: RESPONSIBLE DECISION MAKING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Life Skills in Education
Topic 2.3: Responsible Decision Making
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Responsible Decision Making, part of Life Skills in Education in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Which situations require responsible decisions in life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Responsible Decision Making together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: Learners accomplish the task of sharing experiences encountered on responsible and irresponsible

decisions in day-to-day life

● Unity: Learners collaborate as they create and act skits on responsible decisions on pertinent issues in the

community.

23

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Civic responsibility: Learners share experiences encountered on responsible and irresponsible decisions in day-to- day life.

Suggested learning resources:

Digital devices with assistive technology, braille reference materials, print reference materials with appropriate font and

colour contrast, print and braille learner’s books, braille and print writing materials.

Key skills:

• Analysing the importance of positive public-image.

• Applying strategies of solving conflicts in the community.

• Making responsible decisions in daily life.
